statements.label: supported
statements.text: EVEs in the Aag2 cell line genome group into large loci exceeding 50 kbp, and these loci are marked by a dense presence of LTR retrotransposons.
statements.evidence: organize into large loci (>50 kbp) characterized by high LTR density
statements.note: The abstract reports that EVEs organize into loci of more than 50 kbp characterized by high LTR density.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Genomic loci containing EVEs showed a higher piRNA density than comparable regions lacking EVEs.
statements.evidence: These EVE-containing loci have increased density of piRNAs compared to similar regions without EVEs.
statements.note: The abstract directly compares piRNA density between EVE-containing loci and similar regions without EVEs and reports an increase.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The majority of EVEs in the Aag2 genome derive from flaviviruses such as dengue and Zika virus.
statements.evidence: Endogenous viral elements (EVEs) are sequences from non-retroviral viruses that are inserted into the mosquito genome
statements.note: The abstract describes EVEs only as sequences from non-retroviral viruses and gives no breakdown of which virus families they come from.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The study detected piRNAs originating from EVEs, a pattern matching targeted processing of genomes from persistently infecting viruses.
statements.evidence: we detected EVE-derived piRNAs consistent with a targeted processing of persistently infecting virus genomes
statements.note: The abstract reports finding EVE-derived piRNAs consistent with targeted processing of persistently infecting virus genomes.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: In the developing brain, miRNAs silence their mRNA targets chiefly by cleaving them rather than by blocking their translation.
statements.evidence: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) regulate many cellular events during brain development by interacting with hundreds of mRNA transcripts.
statements.note: The abstract says miRNAs interact with many mRNAs but never states how they silence them, whether by cleavage or by translational block.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The study identified an interaction between miR-2115, a microRNA found only in great apes, and ORC4, a transcript enriched in radial glia.
statements.evidence: One such interaction is between radial-glia-enriched ORC4 and miR-2115, a great-ape-specific miRNA
statements.note: The abstract names the ORC4 and miR-2115 pair, describing ORC4 as radial-glia-enriched and miR-2115 as great-ape-specific.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Using AGO2-HITS-CLIP, single-cell profiling and network analyses, the study found that miRNA-mRNA interactions form functional modules often matching cell-type identities.
statements.evidence: we show that miRNA-mRNA interactions operate as functional modules that often correspond to cell-type identities
statements.note: The abstract reports that the combined approaches revealed miRNA-mRNA interactions acting as functional modules that often correspond to cell types.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The miRNA-mRNA networks changed substantially both across brain development and across evolutionary time.
statements.evidence: These networks are highly dynamic during development and over the course of evolution.
statements.note: The abstract states that the networks are highly dynamic during development and over the course of evolution.
